To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the interface bonding behaviors between asphalt layer and semi rigid base asphalt pavements are affected by many factors,such as the interfacial contact condition,interlayer parameters and so on.

the interfacially shear stress and shear force decrease with the increase of the interfacional friction coefficient,while the interfacial stress and shear force increase with the increase of time and interfacial compressive modulus and interlayer thickness.

the interface bonding behaviors of interface between asphalt layer and semi rigid base asphalt pavements were studied by viscoelastic finite element analysis,which can provide a theoretical basis for the design and maintenance of asphalt pavements.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interface bonding behaviors of the semi rigid base asphalt pavements,and provides a new way to study interface bonding behaviors of pavement.
the interface bonding behaviors of pavement,and provides theoretical basis and guidance for the design of interface bonding behaviors.
the interface bonding behaviors of pavement and the effects of suppositional interlayers on them,and the results are helpful for the design and construction of asphalt pavement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the interfacied shear stress and the interlayer parameters are important to the mechanics response of pavement,and the interface shear force is an indicator of interface bonding behaviors.

the interface bonding behaviors of the pavement is a complex process,and the interfacial contact condition has a great impact on the mechanics responses,thus the bonding behaviors of interface should be considered in the design and construction of pavement.
the interface bonding behaviors of pavement can be improved effectively by optimizing the design parameters of bonding layer and removing the weak bonding.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the viscoelasticity finite analysis method can be used as an effective tool to analyze interface bonding behaviors in semi rigid base asphalt pavements.

the interfacialshear stress distribution and interface bonding behaviors of the pavement can be analyzed by viscoelasticity finiteelement method,and the results are in accordance with the practical engineering.

the interfacially weak bonding is an important reason for pavement distress,especially longitudinal cracks,and the interlayer with strong bonding is the best choice in the design of semi rigid base pavement.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the interface shear stress distribution and interfacial shear forces are affected by the interfacial contact condition and the suppositional interface bonding condition,and they are the important indexes for analyzing interface bonding behaviors of pavement,and it is an important way to enhance interface bonding behaviors to set up bonding interlayer with appropriate parameters.
it can provide a reference for the design and construction of the semi rigid base asphalt pavements in China.

it is necessary to consider the interfacial bonding behaviors of asphalt pavements when designing the pavement structure,and it can provide a theoretical reference to the design of asphalt pavements and the maintenance of existing asphalt pavements.
